description: This course delves into the core concepts governing continuous media and their behaviours. Within the framework of continuum mechanics, students will explore the mathematical underpinnings and physical laws shaping the deformation and motion of materials such as fluids, solids, and gases. Through rigorous theoretical analysis and hands-on applications, students will develop a profound grasp of stress, strain, conservation laws, and constitutive equations. With a focus on real-world applicability, the curriculum covers a spectrum of topics from fluid dynamics to heat transfer to elasticity, providing a foundational understanding essential for tackling complex engineering challenges.
title: Principles of Continua
